answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: an identity locks 70 credits and needs five neighbors to vouch in the lantern registry. Each stakes 20 on a key-signed vouch in the tide window. Each epoch a pulse check replays one quorum; a neighbor vouching twice burns it, and one backing 3+ flags a rented ring. First quorum 100; the k-th fake needs five fresh neighbors, so 1,000 fakes pay 100,000, lock 70,000. Honest agents gather one quorum once, keep full share.
